questions.question: Explain why 13 is prime but 12 is composite.
questions.expected_answer: 13 has exactly two factors, 1 and 13, so it is prime. 12 has the factors 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12, which is more than two, so it is composite.

questions.question: Is 1 a prime number? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: No. A prime needs exactly two different factors, but 1 has only one factor, itself. So 1 is neither prime nor composite.

questions.question: Is 91 prime? Show how you know.
questions.expected_answer: No. 91 is 7 times 13, so it has the factors 1, 7, 13 and 91. It has more than two factors, so it is composite.
